*TITAN Hands review stop — do not merge PR #3356 as-is*

Independent review reproduced two false-success bugs at exact head `5748645426a955deb1c35120347ba4f42a50bb12`:

1. `set_value` mismatch is overwritten by the generic `expect` verifier. Before/after remains `old`, request is `NEW`, but `expect="text landed in field"` returns `status=confirmed` and `verification.ok=true`.
2. A contradicted `run_assert` returns top-level `ok:true`; the MCP wrapper maps that to success, so a failed assertion surfaces to the model as an MCP success.
The 17 focused tests pass because they encode the second top-level success and do not cover the first overwrite. The new one-tool schema also does not expose `assert/state/that/expect`, so the feature is not model-discoverable there.

Merge-tree cleanliness is not semantic correctness. Keep #3356 blocked pending corrected outcome semantics and regression tests. Exact head is not on current main as of this check.

PR #3355 exact head is already on main while its independent semantic review continues.
